description.label: Description
description.value:
Major Physical Mutation

Your body drastically transforms, changing you into a mix of your current species and a foreign type. Consult the @Table[crossbreed] Table to determine which species you transform into. Roll 1d10 to determine how far you transform into the new species: 1-4, 25%, 5-8, 50%, 9-10, 75%. Compare the characteristics of your current species with the new one. Multiply the difference per characteristic with the percentage of your transformation (25%, 50% or 75%) to calculate how your characteristics are affected. You may choose one Creature Trait per 25% of transformation. You and the GM determine how you change cosmetically. If you gain this mutation again you may choose if you want to roll for a new species or progress the level of transformation by +25% with your existing crossbreeding. If you reach 100% transformation then youve changed species into the new one. Change your base characteristics to that of your new race.
